Class GmailAuthHelper

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.gmail.GmailAuthHelper
public class GmailAuthHelper extends Object
Pure Java Google OAuth 2.0 helper managing browser login, authorization code capture, token exchange, and automatic access token refresh for the Gmail API.

Implements a local loopback callback server via HttpServer without external OAuth dependencies.

anahata

  • Method Details

    • getValidAccessToken

      public static String getValidAccessToken(GmailCredentials credentials) throws IOException
      Obtains a valid, unexpired OAuth2 access token for the given credentials.

      If the cached token is expired or absent, automatically refreshes it against Google's token endpoint using the stored refresh token.

      Parameters:
      credentials - The loaded GmailCredentials.
      Returns:
      A valid bearer access token string.
      Throws:
      IOException - If token refresh fails or network errors occur.

    • loginInteractive

      public static GmailCredentials loginInteractive(String clientId, String clientSecret) throws Exception
      Executes the interactive browser OAuth2 login flow using provided client credentials.

      1. Starts a temporary local HTTP server on port 8888 (or ephemeral fallback).
      2. Launches the user's default browser to Google's consent screen.
      3. Intercepts the authorization code redirect.
      4. Exchanges the code for access and refresh tokens.
      5. Queries the authorized account email address.
      6. Persists credentials to ~/.anahata/asi/gmail/credentials.json.

      Parameters:
      clientId - The Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client ID.
      clientSecret - The Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Client Secret.
      Returns:
      The authenticated and persisted GmailCredentials.
      Throws:
      Exception - If user authorization, redirect capture, or token exchange fails.
